caseName: Jones v. North Carolina Prisoners' Labor Union, Inc.
caseNameFull: Jones, Secretary, Department of Correction of North Carolina v. North Carolina Prisoners' Labor Union, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. E. D. N. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 429 U. S. 976.] Motion of the Acting Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae granted and five additional minutes allotted for that purpose.
